title: Working Out the Monthly Management Fee on a Workplace Cafe Management Program Contract
content:
#### What is invoiced each billing period on a cafe management contract?

Each billing period a workplace cafe management contract is invoiced for its management fee, worked out from the monthly management fee printed against the service model standing on the contract on the day the invoice is raised. That fee is the base fee. The management fee is recorded against the billing period it covers.

#### How many escalation steps are counted, and at what rate?

The escalation steps are the whole years between the first day of the contract term and the day the invoice is raised, and the escalation rate is the annual price escalation printed against the service model.

#### How is the escalated fee reached?

The base fee is carried forward at the escalation rate once for each escalation step, and the figure so obtained is the escalated fee, rounded to the nearest cent.

#### What are the co-location allowance, the suspended day relief and the subsidy commitment surcharge?

The co-location allowance is nil, the suspended day relief is nil and the subsidy commitment surcharge is nil. The co-location rate is 0.00 per cent and the subsidy shortfall rate is 0.00 per cent. The co-location allowance is the co-location rate taken on the escalated fee, rounded to the nearest cent. The subsidy commitment surcharge is the subsidy shortfall rate taken on the escalated fee, rounded to the nearest cent.

#### Does a portfolio band discount enter the figure?

The management fee worked out under this rule carries the co-location allowance, the suspended day relief and the subsidy commitment surcharge stated here in place of any portfolio band discount.

#### How do those figures assemble into the management fee invoiced?

The co-location allowance and the suspended day relief are each worked out on the escalated fee and subtracted from it, the subsidy commitment surcharge is worked out on the escalated fee and added to it, and the management fee invoiced is the escalated fee less those two reductions plus that surcharge, rounded to the nearest cent and never below nil. A figure that would otherwise fall below nil is nil.

#### Worked through on hypothetical figures?

Take a contract of the Workplace Cafe Management Program on which the monthly management fee printed against the service model standing on the contract is, hypothetically, 5200.00 USD, the annual price escalation printed against that service model is, hypothetically, 4.00 per cent, and 2 whole years fall between the first day of the contract term and the day the invoice is raised.

The base fee is 5200.00 USD. Carried forward at 4.00 per cent for the first escalation step it becomes 5408.00 USD, and carried forward once more for the second it becomes 5624.32 USD, so the escalated fee is 5624.32 USD. The co-location allowance is 0.00 per cent taken on 5624.32 USD, being 0.00 USD. The suspended day relief is nil, being 0.00 USD. The subsidy commitment surcharge is 0.00 per cent taken on 5624.32 USD, being 0.00 USD. The management fee invoiced is 5624.32 USD less 0.00 USD and less 0.00 USD, plus 0.00 USD, rounded to the nearest cent: 5624.32 USD, recorded against the billing period it covers.
